nom: Estée Lauder DayWear Glow Boost Jelly Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it cleans away oil and daily buildup effectively without leaving skin feeling stripped or tight.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin report it cleanses without stripping or increasing dryness, though a couple were less enthusiastic, with one finding it didn't suit her especially dry skin well in cold weather and another feeling it might work better for oily skin instead.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report it cleanses evenly without irritating either oilier or drier areas.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, with some specifically noting it felt calmer than cleansers that usually leave sensitive or rosacea-prone skin feeling tight; one reviewer, however, experienced irritation and had to stop using it.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cleanser as leaving skin soft, hydrated, and never tight or stripped, even compared to their usual cleansers; a couple of reviewers, however, found it merely non-drying rather than actively hydrating, and one with very dry skin felt it wasn't quite enough during winter.
concerns.redness: The reviewers who specifically mention redness, including two with rosacea, report no increase in redness and say the cleanser felt calming on reactive areas that usually feel tight or irritated after washing.
concerns.barrier: Nearly all reviewers report no irritation, burning, or stinging, describing the cleanser as gentle even with daily use; one reviewer, however, experienced irritation and discontinued use after a couple of nighttime applications.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention breakouts, including some who are acne-prone, consistently report the cleanser did not cause new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin, or whose skin gets oily by the end of the day, report the cleanser removes excess oil effectively without leaving a residue or oily aftertaste.

aspects.libelle: Light cucumber scent, generally well liked
Removes makeup thoroughly without double cleansing
Jelly texture transforms into a light, satisfying foam
Highly concentrated, a little goes a long way
Sample size leaves you wanting more
Considered good value for the brand and price

I used this cleanser at night a couple of times. The product made me my face feel very clean and refreshed. Unfortunately it did cause a bit of irritation so I had to stop using it. I would like to try this again during the summer since my skin is usually drier during the winter. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser did a good job of cleansing my oily, spf-covered skin. A lot of the time after using a cleanser, my face feels very tight. I didn't experience that with this one, so that was wonderful. I do wish that there was not any fragrance, as I prefer using fragrance free skincare. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I am not one to stray from my usual drugstore cleansers. This was offered to me as a sample to try and review and I ended up being really pleased by the results.My skin felt clean and healthy, not stripped or irritated. I am prone to breakouts and dry skin, but this was not irritating at all! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

I truly loved using the DayWear Jelly Cleanser! I washed my face with it in the mornings and my skin feels so smooth and refreshed. It has a nice light scent that isn't very overwhelming, which is something I prefer. It also feels great on my rosacea, where most cleansers tend to make that area feel tighter. I was able to use this cleanser to remove makeup at night as well and it di a great job at that too. Overall, great product! I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: My skin feels fresh,soft and clean
extraits.texte: As a tired mom who sometimes washes her face at 11:47 PM while questioning every life decision, I need a cleanser that works without drama. The Estée Lauder DayWear Cleanser? She understood the assignment. It has this creamy texture that foams just enough to feel satisfying, like you are actually removing the day off your face. Makeup, sunscreen, toddler fingerprints, stress. Gone. But somehow my skin does not feel tight or squeaky stripped after. It feels clean in a rich girl at the spa kind of way, not gas station bathroom soap kind of way. I have combination skin, and this did not freak it out. My T zone felt fresh, my cheeks stayed comfortable, and my skin felt soft and balanced after rinsing. No dryness. No irritation. Just calm, clean, expensive energy. The scent is light and fresh. Not aggressive. Not headache inducing. Just subtle and elevated, like you have your life together even if you absolutely do not. Overall, this feels like a dependable everyday cleanser that makes washing your face feel a little luxurious. And honestly, as a mom, I will take any small moment of luxury I can get.

I love Lancôme products and was really excited to try their skincare line. This is a great everyday cleanser. I have sensitive skin and rosacea and I love how gentle and calming this is! Most cleansers are super drying or irritating but I found my skin still stayed hydrated after using this and didn't react at all. Scent is very mild as well which was great. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
